entities.summary: Claudia L. Tenney is an American attorney and politician serving as the U.S. representative for New York's 24th congressional district since 2023. Previously, she represented the 22nd district from 2017 to 2019 and from 2021 to 2023 and sat in the New York State Assembly from 2011 to 2016. She is a member of the Republican Party. Claudia Tenney was a legal figures from New Hartford (b. 1961-02-04, New Hartford). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
